recipe.visualDefinition: A medium shot of a man in western attire positioned on the left, looking away from the camera, set against a vast outdoor landscape at dusk. The right side of the frame is dedicated to high-contrast, vertically stacked typography with a decorative flourish.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject offset to the left creates a balanced asymmetrical composition.
Warm skin tones and shirt patterns contrast with the cool blue and pale yellow sky.
The verticality of the condensed typeface echoes the upright posture of the subject.
A horizontal rule separates the primary and secondary text blocks.
coreInvariants: Felt cowboy hat with a decorative band
Intricate blue and white paisley patterned western shirt
Low-angle outdoor lighting suggesting golden hour

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Subject occupies the left two-thirds of the frame, from waist up.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's face and hat provide the primary anchor, while the large text block acts as the secondary anchor.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the subject's face, follows his gaze across to the text, then down to the decorative flourish.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Open sky on the right provides a clean canvas for the typography.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Muted blues and whites in the shirt and sky.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep navy blue for the primary display text.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Earth tones (tan, brown) in the hat and landscape.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value in the sky creates a bright backdrop for dark, saturated text.

composition.relationshipToImage: placed over negative space of sky
separated by a thin horizontal line

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: High-contrast condensed serif for the name paired with a widely-spaced slab serif for the title.
graphicDevices: Symmetrical calligraphic flourish (fleuron) centered below subtitle

avoid: Centered alignment for the main name

candidateDirections.nameOrCategory: Onyx or Bodoni Extra Bold Condensed
candidateDirections.reason: Matches the high contrast and narrow width of the display text.
Provides the sturdy, western feel for the subtitle.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: A medium shot of a man with a goatee wearing a tan cowboy hat and a blue/white paisley western shirt. He is standing in a dirt field at sunset, looking off-camera to the right. The background shows a soft-focus horizon with distant hills and streetlights under a clear gradient sky from blue to pale yellow. Leave the right third of the sky empty.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add the primary name in a large, navy blue, extra-condensed modern serif font in the upper right. Below it, draw a thin horizontal line. Under the line, add the subtitle in a smaller, brown, widely-spaced slab serif font. Center a small black decorative scroll flourish underneath the subtitle.

verificationChecks: Is the subject looking away from the text?
Is the primary text navy blue and highly condensed?
Is there a horizontal line separating the two text levels?
Is the shirt pattern a detailed paisley/floral print?

adjustableVariables: Specific style of the decorative flourish
mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the artist
Exact brand logos on the hat band
postGenerationChecks: Text is legible against the sky gradient.
The man's hat does not overlap the primary text.
The paisley pattern on the shirt is clearly visible.
The decorative flourish is centered relative to the subtitle.
recipe.reuseFormula: Subject(Western/Country) + Asymmetrical Layout + Condensed Modern Serif + Wide-Tracked Slab Serif + Sunset Gradient Background
